limitations: Each demographic row describes an entire census block group, using the RFP's listed 2024 ACS values.
A block group's membership in a focus watershed is the RFP table's assignment. Counts are not clipped or prorated by watershed area.
Utility service populations describe another population and are shown separately from block-group totals.
The state-income comparison follows the RFP's reference value. It is a descriptive comparison, not a programme eligibility decision.
Median household incomes remain separate block-group medians; the application reports their range and never averages them into a utility median.
The original poverty percentage is retained beside any computed ratio using the published household numerator and denominator.
Modelled pollutant exports retain their original physical units and spatial coverage. A demographic selection does not assign pollutant mass or exposure to individuals.
The initial source carries the RFP's values and does not contain ACS margins of error or later Census revisions.
